name: Adaptive Rounded Corners
description: Adds adaptive rounded corners to top-level windows in GNOME Shell, including Wayland-native, X11/XWayland, Qt, Electron, and other non-libadwaita apps. Features theme-aware border colours that follow system appearance. GPU-accelerated GLSL shader with squircle support, custom shadows, and per-app settings. Supports GNOME 45–50.
